title: Make missing-origin terminal diagnostics consistent across rescan candidate paths
outcome: The missing-origin refusal has explicit snapshot or refresh semantics even when an unfinished observation also selects the terminal entry.
acceptance: A deterministic fixture covers a diagnosed registration with no native origin, a later host or session prerequisite change, and an unfinished nonmatching observation that also selects the run.

The persisted diagnostic and API remedy follow the documented semantics regardless of whether ordinary retention selects the same entry. No native authority or test credit is granted to the missing-origin run.
